observations.title: Merapi volcano (Indonesia)
observations.description: The Pusat Vulkanologi dan Mitigasi Bencana Geologi (PVMBG) reported that the eruption at Merapi (on Java) continued during 17-23 September with lava avalanches produced by the active lava dome on the upper SW flank. The seismic network recorded up to 12 lava avalanches per day that traveled as far as 2 km down the Sat/Putih and Krasak drainages on the SW flank and the Boyong drainage on the S flank. The Alert Level remained at 3 (on a scale of 1-4), and the public was warned to stay 3-7 km away from the summit, based on location. Source: Pusat Vulkanologi dan Mitigasi Bencana Geologi (PVMBG, also known as CVGHM)
